patronOf.pt-BR: Padroeiro dos presos e das famílias

prayerExcerpt.en-US: Greater love has no one than to lay down his life for his friends.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Ninguém tem maior amor do que aquele que dá a vida por seus amigos.

meta.face: A man in his early forties, balding with close-cropped dark hair, a long dark-brown beard narrowing to a point, small round wire-rimmed spectacles, a straight nose, an earnest gentle gaze.
meta.basis: The 1936 photograph from Japan, the type most photographs and icons follow; the white and red crowns from his childhood vision of the Immaculata. The excerpt is his memorial's communion antiphon.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Maximilian Kolbe (1936 photograph, the two crowns)
